battle.name: 朱古達戰爭
battle.theater: 北非努米底亞與阿特拉斯山麓
battle.brief: 公元前122年，羅馬共和國與北非努米底亞王國開戰，戰線自首都西爾塔伸到穆圖爾河與撒哈拉邊緣，纏鬥七年，最後靠摩洛哥王波庫斯交出朱古達收場。卡面的希臘重步兵一次都沒上過陣：方陣早輸給馬其頓的薩拉沙方陣與羅馬軍團方陣，羅馬靠三段式軍陣與重標槍，努米底亞靠輕騎與游擊。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 朱古達戰爭是羅馬共和國與北非努米底亞王國之間的一場戰爭。本站的戰爭索引把起點訂在公元前122年、以公元前105年朱古達被移交為終點；多數史家則以公元前111年羅馬正式宣戰作為開端。交戰的一方是羅馬共和國：作戰骨幹是公民兵團組成的軍團，戰時以執政官或將軍的命令分三段展開，輔以騎兵、工程兵與糧秣隊；元老院是決策機關，平民保民官蓋烏斯·梅米烏斯在議會與公眾集會上不斷追究對朱古達的和約，駐在非洲的商人階層也因商路與人身安全捲入糾紛。另一方是朱古達統治的努米底亞王國：疆域在今阿爾及利亞北部，首都西爾塔，國力來自中部高原的穀物產區與通往羅馬、迦太基的商路。朱古達在王位爭奪中取得西部土地，得到迦太基的武力支持，迦太基將領博米爾卡曾在努米底亞境內活動；軍中還有馬西利人與高土人的輕騎，以及一批由羅馬逃兵與被釋俘虜組成、跟著朱古達打游擊的叛軍。捲入這場戰爭的第三方是摩洛哥王國，其王波庫斯一世先是朱古達的岳父與盟友，最後反手把朱古達交給了羅馬。
countriesEn: The Jugurthine War was fought between the Roman Republic and the Kingdom of Numidia in North Africa. This site's index dates the conflict from 122 BC and closes it in 105 BC with the handover of Jugurtha, while most historians take the Roman declaration of war in 111 BC as the true opening. One side was the Roman Republic: the backbone of its field army was the citizen levy organised into legions, which fought in three lines under the orders of a consul or a general, supported by cavalry, engineers and supply columns; the Senate was the deciding body, and the plebeian tribune Gaius Memmius repeatedly raised the broken treaty with Jugurtha in the assembly and before the public, while the business class of the equites, who traded in Africa, was drawn into the dispute by its trade routes and by its safety. The other side was the Kingdom of Numidia under Jugurtha: its territory lay in the north of what is now Algeria, its capital was Cirta, and its strength came from the grain lands of the central plateau and from the trade roads to Rome and Carthage. Jugurtha had taken the western part of the kingdom in his struggle for the throne and was backed by Carthaginian military power, with the Carthaginian commander Bomilcar active inside Numidia; his forces also included Massylian and Gaetulian light cavalry, together with a band of deserters and released prisoners who had joined him and fought as a guerrilla force. A third party was drawn in as well: the kingdom of Mauretania, whose king Bocchus I was first Jugurtha's father-in-law and ally, and who finally handed Jugurtha over to Rome.
people: 朱古達是努米底亞王麥基普薩的姪兒兼養子，早年在羅馬將軍小西庇阿旗下打過努曼提亞之圍，學會了羅馬人的做法，也同時被羅馬貴族當作交遊對象。麥基普薩死前把王國分給三個繼承人：長子阿德爾巴爾、次子希姆普薩爾與朱古達。朱古達靠行賂與戰功買下軍心，先後殺死希姆普薩爾、梅爾梅薩，最後逼降阿德爾巴爾；阿德爾巴爾逃到羅馬請元老院仲裁。朱古達的支持者包括迦太基人博米爾卡、據薩盧斯特記載被他收編的羅馬逃兵首領斯佩迪烏斯、高土人那拉伽爾，以及岳父波庫斯一世；馬西利人之王西法克斯起初以兵助朱古達，後來與羅馬修好。羅馬一方的關鍵人物有：仲裁使團的領袖盧基烏斯·奧皮米烏斯、執政官盧基烏斯·卡爾普爾尼烏斯·貝斯提亞與馬爾庫斯·埃米利烏斯·斯凱魯斯、兄弟執政官斯普里烏斯與奧盧斯·波斯圖米烏斯·阿爾比努斯、接手戰事的執政官昆圖斯·凱基利烏斯·梅特魯斯，以及公元前107年以執政官身分接管全軍的蓋烏斯·馬略；隨軍的財務官路基烏斯·科爾內利烏斯·蘇拉在談判中取得朱古達本人，成了他日後政治資本的來源；保民官蓋烏斯·梅米烏斯則是逼羅馬正式宣戰的人。
peopleEn: Jugurtha was the nephew and adopted son of the Numidian king Micipsa. He had served under Scipio Aemilianus at the siege of Numantia, where he picked up Roman habits and formed acquaintances among the Roman aristocracy, who were themselves flattered by his company. Before his death Micipsa divided the kingdom between three heirs: his elder son Adherbal, his younger son Hiempsal and Jugurtha. Buying the loyalty of the army with money and with service in the field, Jugurtha had Hiempsal and then Mermessa murdered and finally drove Adherbal out; Adherbal fled to Rome and asked the Senate to arbitrate. Jugurtha's supporters included the Carthaginian Bomilcar, the Roman deserter Spendius who, according to Sallust, joined him, the Gaetulian Narragal, and his father-in-law Bocchus I; Syphax, king of the Massylii, first backed Jugurtha with troops and then made his peace with Rome. The key figures on the Roman side were Lucius Opimius, who led the commission of arbitration; the consuls Lucius Calpurnius Bestia and Marcus Aemilius Scaurus; the brother consuls Spurius and Aulus Postumius Albinus, who commanded in Africa and were defeated; Quintus Caecilius Metellus, who took over the war; and Gaius Marius, who took command of the whole army as consul in 107 BC. Sulla, who served as Marius' quaestor, obtained Jugurtha himself in the negotiations, the source of the political capital he would later trade on; the tribune Gaius Memmius was the man who forced Rome to declare war.
kits: 卡面上是希臘重步兵：圓盾、短矛、青銅頭盔與貼身甲胄，靠盾牌相接的方陣站立，這套裝備在公元前5世紀定型，卻早已不是本場戰爭的裝備。希臘方陣在公元前4世紀被馬其頓的薩拉沙方陣超越，又在公元前364年與公元前197年兩度被羅馬式軍團方陣正面擊破——尤其公元前197年第二次馬其頓戰爭的犬頸之役，弗拉米尼努斯用軍團方陣打散腓力五世的方陣，同役他還徵用了努米底亞的戰象，等於把本役的兩件主角兵器擺在同一個戰場上。到了朱古達戰爭，羅馬的戰鬥單位是三段式的軍團方陣（manipulus）：青年兵持重標槍，接戰兵上前肉搏，第三列在後支援，裝備是重標槍、短劍與大橢圓盾。努米底亞一方沒有方陣，靠的是北非最好的輕騎兵、能快速衝擊再退走的散騎，以及在穆圖爾河一役出現的戰象與其餘步兵；象兵正是朱古達在貝斯提亞和約中交出的那一批，後來又從貪污的軍官手中低價買回。攻城方是羅馬人的老本行：撞槌、雲梯，以及自希臘化世界流入的配重投石機與雙臂弩炮；沙漠行軍靠灌滿的獸皮水袋，三日無水走到敵方的堡壘塔拉，靠的就是這些水袋與隨軍的載畜隊。
kitsEn: The card shows a Greek hoplite: round shield, short spear, bronze helmet and body armour, a man who stands in a phalanx by overlapping his shield with his neighbour's. That kit was fixed in the fifth century BC, but it was no longer the kit of this war. The Greek phalanx had been surpassed by the Macedonian sarissa phalanx in the fourth century BC and had been beaten twice more by the Roman-style legionary formation, in 364 BC and again in 197 BC, when Flamininus broke Philip V's phalanx at Cynoscephalae in the Second Macedonian War — a battle in which he also employed war elephants from Numidia, putting the two principal weapons of this dossier on the same field. By the time of the Jugurthine War the Roman fighting unit was the manipulus: three lines, the hastati with their heavy javelins, the principes in close combat and the triarii in support, armed with pilum, gladius and the large oval scutum. Numidia had no phalanx at all. It relied on the best light cavalry in North Africa, on mounted skirmishers who could strike and fade away, and on the war elephants that appeared at the Muthul, the very animals Jugurtha surrendered under the treaty with Bestia and later bought back at a discount from corrupt officers. Siege work was the Roman trade: rams, siege towers, and counterweight stone-throwers and two-armed ballistae out of the Hellenistic world. In the desert the army depended on skins filled with water: three days of marching without a drop of water, up to the fortress of Thala, was made possible by those skins and by the baggage train.
tactics: 羅馬軍隊在這場戰爭裡沒有打過一場教科書式的會戰，這本身就是戰術上的教訓。軍團作戰仍循三段式：青年兵以重標槍覆蓋敵陣後輪退，接戰兵上前肉搏，第三列隨時補上，騎兵負責掩護兩翼；元老院與執政官真正要的是佔領城市、逼迫對手，而不是在野外交手。梅特魯斯接手後連下城鎮，圍攻扎馬想逼朱古達出戰，被對方拖成持久戰；馬略接手後西進搶掠、攻下卡普薩、逼近穆盧卡河，同樣沒能迫使對手決戰。朱古達的戰術是主動避戰與分割：他在穆圖爾河一役把騎兵與精銳步兵放在山北，另一支以戰象和其餘步兵逼近河邊，使羅馬兩支縱隊無法互相救援；羅軍靠魯弗斯正面強攻河邊、馬略與梅特魯斯奪取平地上的山頭，才在兩面同時得手。沙漠是他的兵器：波斯圖米烏斯·阿爾比努斯被引入荒漠，一半兵力陣亡，殘部被迫從軛下鑽過；城邑攻守則是另一套本事，西爾塔的持久圍城、塔拉四十日的圍城都靠掘壕與圍牆完成。最後結束戰爭的不是會戰，而是波庫斯在外交上的背叛與蘇拉的談判。
tacticsEn: In this war the Romans never fought the textbook set-piece battle, and that in itself is the lesson of the tactics. The legion still fought in three lines: the hastati covered the enemy with their heavy javelins and withdrew, the principes closed in hand to hand, the triarii in the third line filled in as needed, and the cavalry covered the flanks. What the Senate and the consuls actually wanted was the capture of towns and the exhaustion of the enemy, not a collision in the open. Metellus marched on town after town, besieged Zama in the hope of forcing Jugurtha to accept a battle, and was drawn into a war of attrition; Marius, who took over, plundered to the west, stormed Capsa and pushed towards the river Muluccha, and likewise could not force a decision. Jugurtha's method was to avoid battle and to divide the enemy: at the Muthul he put his cavalry and best infantry on one side of the mountains and a second detachment with the war elephants and the rest of the infantry near the river, so that the two Roman columns could not support each other; the Romans won on both fronts only because Rufus charged straight down to the river while Marius and Metellus seized the hill on the plain. The desert was his weapon: Postumius Albinus was lured into the wasteland, half his army was killed and the survivors were forced to pass under a yoke. Siege and blockade were another craft of his: the long blockade of Cirta and the forty days at Thala were won with trenches and walls. What ended the war was not a battle but Bocchus' diplomatic betrayal and Sulla's negotiation.
data: 年表是這場戰爭最可靠的部分：麥基普薩在公元前118年去世，羅馬的仲裁使團在公元前116年劃分努米底亞，朱古達在公元前113年再啟戰爭、圍困西爾塔，公元前111年元老院正式宣戰，同年貝斯提亞與斯凱魯斯議和，公元前110至前109年波斯圖米烏斯兄弟相繼在非洲指揮並敗績，前109年梅特魯斯抵任並在穆圖爾河擊敗朱古達，前108年奪下塔拉，前107年馬略接任，前105年波庫斯交出朱古達，前104年朱古達在羅馬被處決，馬略同時獲得凱旋。距離與時間也有具體記載：穆圖爾河與朱古達據守的山脈平行、相距約十八英里，羅軍必須分兩縱隊同時作戰；通往塔拉的沙漠路要走三日而沿途無水；圍塔拉整整四十日，羅軍靠獸皮水袋維持軍隊運作。古代史料對雙方兵員多不給確數，薩盧斯特本人就說他記不清羅馬出兵的數目，所以此處只列有根據的年、里、與日數，不去湊軍人數。戰利品一端另有細節：和約規定朱古達交出戰象，他後來卻以低價買回。
dataEn: The chronology is the most reliable part of this war. Micipsa died in 118 BC; a Roman commission divided Numidia in 116 BC; Jugurtha renewed the war and besieged Cirta in 113 BC; the Senate declared war in 111 BC, and in the same year Bestia and Scaurus made a treaty; in 110 and 109 BC the brothers Postumius commanded in Africa and were beaten; Metellus arrived in 109 BC and defeated Jugurtha at the Muthul; Thala was taken in 108 BC; Marius took over in 107 BC; Bocchus handed Jugurtha over in 105 BC; Jugurtha was executed in Rome in 104 BC, in the same year as Marius' triumph. Distances and durations are also recorded: the Muthul ran parallel to the mountains in which Jugurtha had his position, about eighteen miles away, so the Romans had to fight with two columns at once; the desert road to Thala took three days without water; the siege of Thala lasted forty days, and the Romans kept the army going with skins full of water. Ancient sources give few exact figures for the numbers on either side — Sallust says outright that he does not remember the size of the Roman force — so only the years, the miles and the days that are documented are given here, and no head-count is invented. There is one further documented detail about booty: the treaty required Jugurtha to hand over his war elephants, and he later bought them back at a reduced price.
cause: 直接起因是王位繼承。前118年麥基普薩去世前，把王國分給三個繼承人：阿德爾巴爾、希姆普薩爾與朱古達。朱古達是姪兒兼養子，身份最低但最敢於用賄賂和兵權經營自己的位置；希姆普薩爾被刺殺，梅爾梅薩隨後死去，阿德爾巴爾逃到羅馬。元老院受朱古達的賄賂而軟弱，派出以奧皮米烏斯為首的使團劃分疆土，朱古達用錢換走了肥沃的西部，阿德爾巴爾只餘東部。公元前113年朱古達再起兵攻擊西爾塔，執政官斯凱魯斯的外交調停下不了圍城，阿德爾巴爾開城被殺，城中隨軍的羅馬人員亦遭殺害。羅馬國內因公民商人受困而輿情沸騰，保民官梅米烏斯在議會上追問和約的賄賂，公元前111年元老院正式宣戰。可是第一任執政官貝斯提亞收取賄賂而議和，幾乎把整個王國交還朱古達；朱古達又在羅馬暗殺堂兄馬西瓦，激怒輿情，戰事重開。接著阿爾比努斯兄弟在沙漠慘敗、被迫接受羞辱的和約，元老院拒絕批准，戰爭才在公元前109年由梅特魯斯接手時進入真正階段。
causeEn: The immediate cause was a succession. Before his death in 118 BC, Micipsa divided the kingdom between three heirs: Adherbal, Hiempsal and Jugurtha. Jugurtha was the nephew and adopted son, the lowest in rank of the three, but the one most willing to buy his position with money and military power. Hiempsal was assassinated, Mermessa died soon after, and Adherbal fled to Rome. The Senate, bought off by Jugurtha, was too weak to do more than send a commission headed by Opimius to divide the kingdom; Jugurtha paid for the fertile western half and left Adherbal the east. In 113 BC he attacked Cirta again; the diplomacy of the consul Scaurus could not raise the siege, Adherbal opened his gates and was killed, and the Romans who were with him in the city were killed as well. Public feeling in Rome ran high because Roman traders were caught in the siege, and the tribune Memmius pursued the bribes behind the treaty in the assembly, until the Senate declared war in 111 BC. The first consul on the job, Bestia, took a bribe and made peace, handing back almost the whole kingdom to Jugurtha; Jugurtha then murdered his cousin Massiva in Rome, which enraged the crowds and reopened the war. The defeat of the Postumius brothers in the desert and the humiliating peace they had to sign were repudiated by the Senate, and only in 109 BC, when Metellus took over, did the war enter its real phase.
impact: 這場戰爭的餘波遠比戰場本身長。第一，它把羅馬的貪腐攤在陽光下：一位國王可以用錢買通元老、將軍與保民官，讓羅馬的使團在仲裁時把王國拱手讓人。薩盧斯特把它寫成《朱古達戰爭》，並說這是羅馬道德衰敗的開端之一。第二，它逼出了馬略的軍隊改革：馬略為湊足兵員而廢除財產資格，招募無產者入伍，羅馬軍隊從此更像一支職業軍，而不再只是公民的臨時徵召；這條路通往前91年的同盟者戰爭與前88年的內戰。第三，蘇拉因為在談判中取得朱古達而嶄露頭角，此後他手上戴著刻有朱古達被擒的戒指，最終走向與馬略的對決。第四，摩洛哥王波庫斯吞併努米底亞西部，成為羅馬的「人民之友」，羅馬在北非的影響因此從迦太基邊境一路推到撒哈拉；努米底亞王國本身直到公元前46年才被劃為羅馬行省。第五，戰爭遺下的裝備與戰術經驗——努米底亞輕騎、迦太基式象兵——在往後的希臘化戰爭中繼續被羅馬收編。
impactEn: The aftermath of this war lasted far longer than the campaign itself. First, it laid Rome's corruption bare: a king could buy senators, generals and tribunes, and hand the Roman commission a kingdom in the course of an arbitration. Sallust wrote it up as the Bellum Iugurthinum and called it one of the openings of Rome's moral decline. Second, it forced Marius' military reform: to fill the ranks he dropped the property qualification and enrolled the propertyless, and the Roman army became something closer to a standing force than a levy of citizens — the road that led to the Social War of 91 BC and to the civil war of 88 BC. Third, Sulla made his name by obtaining Jugurtha in negotiation, and thereafter wore a ring engraved with the capture of Jugurtha; he was the man who would eventually stand against Marius. Fourth, Bocchus annexed the west of Numidia and became a friend of the Roman people, so that Roman influence in North Africa was pushed from the Carthaginian frontier to the edge of the Sahara; Numidia itself did not become a Roman province until 46 BC. Fifth, the equipment and the tactical lessons of the war — Numidian light horse, Carthaginian-style elephants — were taken over by Rome and carried into the Hellenistic wars that followed.
result: 公元前105年，摩洛哥王波庫斯假意把朱古達交給蘇拉，隨即在羅馬人監視下把追隨朱古達的餘部屠殺殆盡。朱古達被戴上鎖鍊押回羅馬，關進地下牢房圖利烏姆，公元前104年在馬略的凱旋之後被處決；波庫斯吞併了努米底亞西部，成為羅馬的友邦，戰爭以這種外交式勝利收場。羅馬方面的結果更複雜：元老院拒絕承認貝斯提亞與波斯圖米烏斯先後簽下的和約，也不接受馬略靠兵武力打不贏這場戰爭，最後是元老院內部撕裂、馬略的民眾派取得戰場指揮權，才換來一個名義上完勝的結局。跟著朱古達打游擊的羅馬逃兵殘部在北非又撐了數年，直到被鎮壓下去。回頭看卡面上的希臘重步兵：方陣在這場戰爭裡一次都沒有上過場，因為早在馬其頓的薩拉沙方陣之後它就已經輸過兩次，羅馬人自己用軍團方陣取勝，朱古達人則用輕騎與游擊拖住羅馬——最後解決這場戰爭的，既不是方陣，也不是會戰，而是一紙背叛與一場外交交易。
resultEn: In 105 BC the king of Mauretania, Bocchus, handed Jugurtha over to Sulla under the pretence of a friendly gesture, and then, in front of Roman eyes, cut down the last of Jugurtha's followers. Jugurtha was put in chains and taken to Rome, shut in the underground prison called the Tullianum, and executed in 104 BC after Marius' triumph; Bocchus annexed the western half of Numidia and became a friend of Rome, and the war ended in this diplomatic victory. The Roman results are more complicated: the Senate refused to recognise the treaties signed first by Bestia and then by Postumius, and it refused to accept that Marius could not win the war by force of arms; only the split inside the Senate and the triumph of Marius' popular party, which carried the command of the field, produced an outcome that looked like a complete victory. The Roman deserters who had followed Jugurtha held out in North Africa for several more years before being hunted down. Looking back at the hoplite on the card: the phalanx never once took the field in this war, having already lost twice — to the Macedonian sarissa phalanx and to the Roman legionary formation. The Romans won with the three-line legion and the heavy javelin; the Numidians held the war open with light horse and irregular warfare. What finally settled the war was neither a phalanx nor a set-piece battle, but a betrayal and a diplomatic bargain.
